notes.note: 0511.bla: #0.3 and #0.5 play only when the leader is Rider 1 (chara id 1); the extractor's '00' label is the leader placeholder. Rider 1 recognises Garagaranda (Ambassador Hell). Every other leader gets #0.11+k / #0.25 / #0.26+k instead.

#0.11-0.24 leader variants. 0511.bla Pt_Chara_Check chain sets k: RX 0, Den-O 1, W 2, OOO 3, Taro 4 (id 13), Zero 5, Mebius 6, Seven 7, Ultraman 8, Nu 9, Zeta 10, God 11, Wing Zero 12, 00 13. So #0.11 RX, #0.12 Momotaros (rough 'snake bastard'), #0.13 Shotaro, #0.14 OOO, #0.15-0.24 identical 'What are you...!!'. Dropped verb in #0.11 restored ('Don't tell me you're...!!', deliberately cut off).

#0.26-0.39 same order as #0.11-0.24: #0.27 Momotaros (yagaru: 'Real full of yourself'), #0.31 Zero (casual 'up to'), #0.35 Nu (statement form), #0.37 God (no 'here'). Identical Japanese kept identical. 'Supreme Executive' for saikou kanbu; 'Super Shocker' is the franchise's established name.
'Monster Zoo' for the pun on doubutsuen (zoo) vs kaibutsuen; no established term found.
Speaker ??? (CHARA_NAME 30) is King Pandon before its name is revealed; cry styled after Pandon's 'Kiiiiiih!!' (story_084).
'ano Pandon' = the Pandon fought in the previous Cube (0454), hence 'that Pandon'.
Dada's gender unknown (glossary n): 'it' / 'the alien' used for Dada in narration (#0.3, #0.12).
No name box in the script; Dada's choked cries while being eaten. 'Dea' rendered as a gasp 'Daah'.

#0.14-0.25 leader variants per 0514.bla chain (k = row-14): Mebius, Zero, Nu, OOO, W, Zeta, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, God, Wing Zero, 00; Rider 1 and RX are #0.29-0.30 (story_092), and k=17 (Den-O) points past the table. Wording fits (boku = Mebius, ore = Zero, 'yaru no ka' = Shotaro, God combines both).
'Kuru no ka!?' addressed to Bogal; subject restored as 'Are you coming at us!?'.
Source has a trailing full-width space; dropped.
{8074} = party-leader name variable; padding dropped per brief.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader-variant orders read from 0511.bla and 0514.bla (id 13 = Taro now in the chains). #0.3/#0.5 of 0511 are Rider 1-only lines mislabelled 00. 'Supreme Executive', 'Monster Zoo', 'Snow Woman Kaiju' are new renderings, not in glossary.
